name: two-phase-extension
description: Phase 2 extends a finished Phase 1: five ordered fresh sessions run the phase-2 chain (spec, rules, ux, ui, build) in one retained project. Each cumulative artifact must be edited rather than re-emitted, Phase 1's behaviour and untouched regions must survive byte-identically, the active phase must not drift across the session boundaries, and no step may open Phase 1's own non-cumulative brief.

steps.prompt: mano ui. The existing visual direction is approved — extend the design artifacts for this phase now, without another preference checkpoint.
